name: Weather
description: The weather at the device's location from OpenWeatherMap: now, the next hours, the next days. One page per view.

properties.name: apiKey
properties.title: API Key
properties.description: Your OpenWeatherMap key. The free plan is enough. A new key can take a couple of hours to start working.

properties.name: units
properties.title: Units
properties.description: auto: miles and Fahrenheit in the US timezones, kilometres and Celsius elsewhere.

properties.name: cacheHours
properties.title: Keep an Answer (hours)
properties.description: How long what OpenWeatherMap answered is kept and shared by every page and task, so the free plan's calls are for new answers only. 0: ask every time. The weather now can be this old, so a shorter time suits a page that shows it.

properties.name: staleDays
properties.title: Forget Unused Answers After (days)
properties.description: A kept answer nobody has used for this many days (a place you moved away from) is removed. 0: never.

properties.name: views
properties.title: Views
properties.description: One page per view, in this order: the weather now, the next day in steps of three hours, the next days. Two or three views make a slot of that many pages. The place is the device's location (System settings).

properties.name: title
properties.title: Title
properties.description: The heading above each page. Empty: the place's name.

properties.name: fontSize
properties.title: Text Size
properties.description: The size of the text on the page.
